atAGlance: Cà ri dê is goat curry with a rich spiced broth, often eaten with bread or noodles so you can soak up the curry and tender goat pieces.
whatItIs: Cà ri dê is goat curry with coconut, warm spices, potatoes or taro, and herbs, often eaten with bread, noodles, or rice.
howToEnjoy: Use bread or noodles to catch the coconut-spiced curry broth. Goat can be rich, so herbs and chili should be added gradually.
howLocalsOrder: Order cà ri dê and choose bread, noodles, or rice if asked. Say ít cay if you want the coconut and spice without much heat.
worthKnowing: Goat curry is a favorite at many Vietnamese dê restaurants, where the meat is shared across grilled, steamed, and curry dishes.
goodToKnow: This is a curry bowl, not a quick dip. Tear bread into the broth or alternate spoonfuls with noodles so the goat, spice, and coconut richness stay together.
